title: How does Pinnacle Blooms aid children with autism in managing their frustrations and emotional meltdowns?
metaTitle: Managing Emotional Outbursts in Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network aids children with autism in managing their frustrations and emotional meltdowns using a combained effort of ABA and Occupational Therapies.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms, we understand that emotional meltdowns can significantly impact not just a child with autism but also their entire family. That's why we deploy a comprehensive approach combining ABA Therapy and Occupational Therapy to help manage these situations. ABA Therapy equips kids with the methods to comprehend their feelings and communicate effectively, which can help lessen the risk of emotional outbursts. On the other hand, Occupational Therapy can address sensory discomforts that often precipitate these meltdowns, providing the child with a much-needed relief.
